lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A grid-like arrangement of high-luminance circular pixel clusters organized into distinct vertical columns posterior to the branchial region, with inter-centroid spacing increasing as they move toward the posterior trunk.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity that intersect the circular high-luminance blobs, creating a discernible lattice pattern of anchor nodes across the mid-flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three prominent horizontal linear features exhibiting a sharp vertical luminance gradient, with high-intensity light on the superior edge and a defined shadow on the inferior edge, spanning the upper lateral flank.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of multiple small, elongated teleost fish positioned ventrally beneath the pectoral fin and along the posterior belly line.
